summary: Completed frontend testing of Accounting UX improvements (Daybook tab and clickable Chart of Accounts). Both new features are functional but have critical UX bugs preventing full usability.

critical_bugs.issue: Close button and backdrop are not clickable - z-index/overlay issue prevents users from closing the panel
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot close the Account Ledger Panel, blocking all other interactions on the Accounting page
critical_bugs.details: The panel has z-[200] but elements like header (z-20), search inputs, and other overlays are intercepting pointer events. Applied z-[201] to panel content div but needs verification.

critical_bugs.issue: Debit/Credit accounting entry table not displaying in transaction detail modal
critical_bugs.impact: Users cannot see the double-entry accounting details when clicking a transaction in Daybook
critical_bugs.details: Modal opens successfully but the table with Debit/Credit columns is missing or not rendering. The modal text check found 'Debit' and 'Credit' missing from the modal content.

regression_issues.issue: Cannot click Dashboard, Income, Expense, Reports, Balance Sheet, or Cash Flow tabs when Account Ledger Panel is open
regression_issues.root_cause: Account Ledger Panel backdrop/overlay blocking all interactions

passed_tests: All Time preset clickable and loads 8 transactions
Summary cards display correctly: 8 transactions, ₹13,37,500 Money In, ₹48,000 Money Out
Daybook search filters transactions (5 rows for 'payment', 8 rows when cleared)
Daybook type filters work (Money In: 6 rows, Money Out: 1 row, All: 8 rows)
Transaction detail modal opens when clicking a row
Chart of Accounts tab renders with 'View ledger' affordance
Clicking account row opens Account Ledger Panel
Account Ledger Panel displays account name (Bank - Primary)
All four summary cells present (closing balance, transaction count, total debit, total credit)
All Time preset in ledger panel loads transactions
Ledger search functionality works (filters and clears correctly)

success_percentage.daybook_features: 85% (search, filters, presets work; modal has display issue)
success_percentage.account_ledger_features: 70% (panel opens, data loads, search works; close button broken)
success_percentage.regression: 0% (all existing tabs blocked by unclosable panel)

action_item_for_main_agent.details: The close button ([data-testid='ledger-close-btn']) and backdrop ([data-testid='account-ledger-backdrop']) are not clickable due to z-index/overlay conflicts. Elements like the sticky header (z-20) and search inputs are intercepting pointer events. The panel div has z-[200] but the content div needs proper z-index stacking. I added z-[201] to line 59 but this needs testing and may require adjusting the entire z-index hierarchy.

The transaction detail modal ([data-testid='txn-detail-modal']) opens when clicking a Daybook row, but the Debit/Credit accounting entry table is not displaying. The modal should show a table with Account, Debit, Credit columns and a Total row showing balanced double-entry. Verify the TransactionDetail component in /app/frontend/src/components/Daybook.jsx lines 252-308.
Once the Account Ledger Panel close issue is fixed, verify that all existing tabs (Dashboard, Income, Expense, Reports, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) are still accessible and render without errors.
